main.summary: Describes one sequential source part exposed by a .

property.name: SourceOffset
property.summary: Gets the source offset at which the part begins.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the number of bytes exposed from the source.

main.summary: Reads an ordered sequence of source stream parts as one non-seekable stream.

field.name: Parts
field.summary: The ordered source parts exposed by the composite stream.

field.name: TotalLength
field.summary: The total number of bytes exposed by all source parts.

field.name: PartIndex
field.summary: The index of the next source part to open.

field.name: Current
field.summary: The currently open source stream, if any.

field.name: CurrentRemaining
field.summary: The number of bytes remaining from the current source part.

field.name: Disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the composite stream has been disposed.

field.name: PositionValue
field.summary: The number of bytes returned to the consumer.

constructor.name: CompositeReadStream
constructor.summary: Initializes a composite reader over ordered source parts.
constructor.param: The ordered source parts to expose.

property.name: CanRead
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the composite stream can be read.

property.name: CanSeek
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the composite stream does not support seeking.

property.name: CanWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the composite stream does not support writing.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the total length of the composite stream.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Gets the number of bytes read from the composite stream; setting the position is not supported.

method.name: Flush
method.summary: Flushing is not supported by the read-only composite stream.

method.name: FlushAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously flushes the composite stream; flushing is not supported.
method.returns: A task that faults because flushing is not supported.

method.name: ReadArray
method.summary: Reads bytes from the composite stream into an array buffer.
method.param: Starting offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.

method.name: ReadSpan
method.summary: Reads bytes from the composite stream into a span buffer.

method.name: ReadAsyncArray
method.summary: Asynchronously reads bytes from the composite stream into an array buffer.
method.param: Starting offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of bytes read.

method.name: ReadAsyncMemory
method.summary: Asynchronously reads bytes from the composite stream into memory.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with the number of bytes read.

method.name: Seek
method.summary: Seeking is not supported by the composite stream.
method.returns: This method always throws because seeking is not supported.

method.name: SetLength
method.summary: Changing the composite stream length is not supported.

method.name: Write
method.summary: Writing is not supported by the read-only composite stream.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Disposes the composite stream and its currently open source.
method.param: True when called from deterministic disposal; otherwise false.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously disposes the composite stream and its currently open source.

method.name: ThrowIfDisposed
method.summary: Throws when the composite stream has already been disposed.

method.name: SkipAsync
method.summary: Advances a source stream by the requested number of bytes.
method.returns: True when the requested offset was reached; otherwise false.
